title: The town holds
text: Your committee publishes two names that winter. Both shops lose customers, and one closes. Imports into the colonies fall sharply through 1775. Your town is counted among those that held firm, and some neighbors no longer speak to one another.

title: A line that bends
text: Mr. Hale sells his old stock and orders nothing new. Some townspeople call it sensible. Others say a rule with exceptions is not a rule, and ask who decides which goods are old.

title: Standing apart
text: Word travels that your town will not enforce the agreement. The Association told people to break off all dealings with anyone who broke it, and to cut off trade with any colony that did. Merchants in neighboring towns grow reluctant to deal with yours.
